{%- comment -%}
  Every documentation page as one plain-text file, for assistants that ingest a
  whole site in a single fetch. Jekyll exposes an already-rendered page as HTML,
  so the content is stripped back to text and the entities Markdown escaped in
  code blocks are decoded again — otherwise `<host>` would read as `&lt;host&gt;`.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign base = site.url | append: site.baseurl -%}
# checkfleet — full documentation

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}
> Source: {{ base }}/ · Repository: {{ site.github.repo }}
> This file is the plain-text concatenation of every page of the documentation
> site. The structured index lives at {{ '/llms.txt' | absolute_url }}.

{% assign pages = site.html_pages | where_exp: "p", "p.nav_order" | sort: "nav_order" -%}
{% for p in pages -%}
{%- assign text = p.content | strip_html | replace: '&lt;', '<' | replace: '&gt;', '>' | replace: '&quot;', '"' | replace: '&#39;', "'" | replace: '&amp;', '&' -%}
================================================================================
# {{ p.title }}
URL: {{ p.url | absolute_url }}
{% if p.description %}Summary: {{ p.description | strip_newlines }}{% endif %}
================================================================================
{{ text | strip }}

{% endfor -%}
